General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Plastic Clips that attach the rods to the Latch, Cylinder and Handles so that they move together.
These have a typical lifespan of around 20 years before they get brittle and break. So if your door doesn’t open when you pull up on the handle or the door doesn’t unlock when you turn the lock cylinder, then this is more than likely the problem.
This is a simple replacement and doesn’t require special tools.
Each Door/Tailgate takes Qty 4 Clips
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 4 – Plastic Lock Clips (Note: Picture only shows 3 but 4 will be shipped)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
Suzuki Sidekick 1989 – 1998 All Models
Suzuki X-90 All Years
Geo Tracker 1989 – 1998 All Models
All Suzuki Vehicles from 1986 – 2000
